features.purpose: List oscilloscopes reachable over USB/LAN through PyVISA (NI-VISA or pyvisa-py).
features.expected: Exit 0 and a clear 'no instrument' message (no hardware attached here)
features.actual: exit 0; No instruments found (Visa Library at py). Check the USB/LAN cable, that the scope is on, its USB mode (USBTMC) and the VISA driver; see hardware/HARDWARE_GUIDE.md, H2.

features.purpose: Acquire repeated traces, save each with a metadata header, append one row per trace to lab_log.csv, print a live baseline check (same code path as the real scope, SimScope instead of VISA).
features.procedure: 7 setups x 4 repeats: open 2/5/10 m, short 5 m, matched 5 m, 100 ohm and 22 ohm loads at 5 m
features.expected: 28 CSV files + 28 log rows; live distance within 0.3 m of the cable length
features.actual: 28 traces + log rows written; quick-check distances: 2 m open -> 2.04 m; 5 m open -> 5.07 m; 10 m open -> 10.11 m; 5 m short -> 5.06 m; 5 m partial 100 ohm -> 5.07 m; 5 m partial 22 ohm -> 5.05 m

features.purpose: Parse a saved trace (vendor auto-detection), preprocess it, run the baseline and plot it.
features.expected: Distance within 0.3 m of 5 m, class open, PNG written
features.actual: exit 0; vendor/format detected; baseline d = 5.065 m (true 5.00); plot saved = True

features.purpose: Fit round-trip delay vs length over open-circuit traces to get vp, the fixed time offset, rise time, resolution, V_inc and noise; writes data/calibration.json used by every later step.
features.procedure: `index.py calibrate` on the 12 open-circuit traces from F02 (2, 5, 10 m)
features.expected: vp within 1.5 % of the simulator's true vp; calibration.json + fig0 written
features.actual: vp = 1.9616e+08 m/s vs simulated truth 1.9786e+08 (-0.86 %); t_offset 0.23 ns; rise 4.15 ns; resolution 0.41 m; SNR 30.5 dB

features.purpose: Least-squares fit of the transmission-line simulator to one measured trace (vp, rise, loss, scope C, Rs, gain).
features.actual: exit 0; RMSE 0.0238 (normalised); fitted vp 1.972e+08 m/s; overlay figure written

features.purpose: Turn every logged lab trace into model inputs (Method A grid, Method B features) + labels.
features.expected: data/processed/lab.csv with 28 rows and a (28, 256) Method A matrix
features.actual: exit 0; 28 traces processed; Method A matrix (28, 256)

features.purpose: Random cables, faults, rise times, noise and scope effects -> labelled traces + both model inputs.
features.procedure: `index.py simulate --n 400 --raw` (calibrated vp from F04 is used)
features.expected: 400 rows, X (400, 256), all 4 classes, finite values
features.actual: exit 0; 400 labelled traces, X (400, 256), classes {'matched': 108, 'open': 100, 'short': 99, 'partial': 93}, raw traces saved

features.feature: Synthetic dataset, brief's simple model + lab artifacts
features.purpose: The brief's analytic model and the proxy-lab artifact generator (adapter, ringing, 1/f noise).
features.expected: 200 rows written, source tagged as artifacts

features.purpose: Late-time level must equal 1 + Gamma (Gamma = (ZL - Z0)/(ZL + Z0)) and the echo must arrive at 2L/vp.
features.procedure: Noiseless traces at 5 m for 8 terminations / faults, normalised by V_inc
features.expected: Every level within 0.03 of theory (small cable loss allowed)
features.actual: final level / theory 1+Gamma: open: 1.985/2.000; short: 0.015/0.000; matched gamma=0: 1.000/1.000; partial zl=100: 1.328/1.333; partial zl=22: 0.617/0.611; partial kind=1,r_fault=50: 1.328/1.333; partial kind=2,r_fault=50: 0.672/0.667; partial kind=3,z2=75: 1.197/1.200; worst deviation 0.015; delay = 2L/vp to 0.000 ns

features.purpose: Threshold + matched-lobe reflection finder on the denoised derivative; gives dt, distance, Gamma and class.
features.procedure: 300 random simulated traces at SNR 40 dB and 300 at 20 dB
features.expected: At 40 dB: median distance error < 0.25 m (half the 0.4-0.5 m resolution of a 4-5 ns edge) and class accuracy > 0.9
features.actual: SNR 40 dB: median |err| 0.17 m, mean 0.20 m, class acc 0.99, missed 1%; SNR 20 dB: median |err| 0.16 m, mean 0.30 m, class acc 0.81, missed 21%

features.feature: Model training with validation grid search (train)
features.purpose: Simulate train/val sets, grid-search every family on the validation set only, keep the best of each.
features.expected: 18 models in models/tdr_models.joblib and a validation_grid.csv
features.actual: exit 0; 18 models stored (RF/ET/KNN/MLP x A/B + CNN-A, regression + classification); best val MAE ET-B 3.36 ns; best val macro-F1 ET-B 0.977
features.performance: 1.1 min for 2000 + 500 traces incl. grid search

features.purpose: How long one trace takes from raw samples to a distance + class, per model, single and batched.
features.procedure: 200 simulated traces; time the front end and each stored model (single-trace and batched calls)
features.expected: Well under 1 s per trace end to end (interactive use)
features.actual: front end (preprocess + baseline + 23 features) 0.7 ms/trace; single-trace model call 0.62-22.8 ms (slowest KNN-A reg); batched 0.008-0.24 ms/trace
features.performance: measured on this laptop's CPU (small self-test models); full-size numbers: index.py analyze

features.purpose: Run all six experiments, write result tables, ten figures and the summary.
features.procedure: `index.py evaluate --quick` with the F02 traces present as the lab log
features.expected: Exit 0, fig1..fig10 and summary.md written; E3/E4 run on the logged traces
features.actual: exit 0; 11 figures, summary.md written; E3/E4 data source captured (lab-format) traces; best regressor ET-B, best classifier ET-B

features.purpose: Run the dashboard script headless and drive the sidebar through all 8 fault types and the saved-trace source; every tab is executed on each run.
features.procedure: streamlit.testing AppTest with the trained sandbox models and captured traces
features.expected: No exception on any run, 5 tabs rendered
features.actual: exit 0; 9 script runs (8 fault types + saved lab trace), no exceptions; tabs 5

features.purpose: Start the real Streamlit server headless and query its health endpoint and index page.
features.procedure: `streamlit run app/dashboard.py --server.headless true` on a free port
features.expected: Health endpoint answers 'ok' and the page is served

features.purpose: Wrong or missing inputs must stop with a one-line explanation, not a Python traceback.
features.procedure: 7 deliberately wrong invocations (missing/garbage files, missing arguments, unknown command)
features.expected: Non-zero exit (or a clear 'nothing to do' message) and no traceback
features.actual: inspect missing file: exit 1, clean message; inspect garbage CSV: exit 1, clean message; capture without length: exit 2, clean message; calibrate without log: exit 2, clean message; fit missing file: exit 1, clean message; lab-dataset without log: exit 0, clean message; unknown command: exit 2, clean message
